pages.text: Prepare 24 tempered steel, 20 Gun Screws and one tempered spring. Assemble one complete lock.$(br2)Finish two short barrels, then join them into the reinforced long barrel.
Make three hardwood blanks. Bind one into a pistol stock, then combine it with the other two blanks for this rifle stock.

Make six bands in total: two for the long barrel, two for its stock and two for final assembly. Prepare one ramrod.$(br2)Six precision mechanisms are consumed throughout the chain. A finished pistol is never an ingredient.
